facts.fact: The Controller and Accountant-General said on 28 July 2025 that his office is procuring handheld biometric devices to verify public workers using the NIA number.
facts.system: Handheld biometric verification against the NIA number

GHA.note: Nothing stated on civil register and ID links.

facts.fact: The Controller and Accountant-General said the government payroll database was linked to the National Identification Authority database in 2024, with over 14,000 unverified workers and 53,307 separated staff still on the wage bill per the 2025 Mid-Year Budget.

GHA.note: No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.
Nothing stated on who runs the ID system.

facts.fact: The Controller and Accountant-General said the government payroll database was linked with the National Identification Authority database in 2024, and that workers are to be verified using the NIA number.

GHA.note: The NIA number is named only as a verification key; nothing on the system itself.
